quizGuardRationale: Exclusions are direct, symmetric and nontransitive, for actual ordinary meanings or underqualified English labels. Existing baseline declarations remain unchanged; no topic/homophone clique inferred.
言付ける protects conveying, entrusting and sending on 伝える/預ける/送る, while keeping the intermediary requirement explicit. General speech 話す is not automatically message delivery.
言葉遣い protects word/language/expression/wording on 言葉/言語/表現/文句. 敬語's honorific/polite qualification does not cover rough manner of speech, so no automatic pair.
こないだ protects このあいだ/先日/最近 recent-past meanings. A precise date is not supplied.

こぼす/零れる share spilling despite transitivity; each independently protects applicable overflow/fall labels. こぼす separately protects actual complaints on 文句/不平/苦情/訴える and four independently checked grumbling mimetics, not a generalized sound/movement clique.
ゴム protects ガム's material sense and 消しゴム's eraser/rubber meaning, not tooth gums or every English gum sense.

ごめん and ごめんください protect separately applicable apology/visiting uses. ごめん further protects refusal/unwillingness on 断る/嫌/うんざり and actual authorization/forgiveness on 許可/免許/許す; a response forgiving is not taught as the speaker's apology.
小指 protects the broad finger/toe label on 指, not distinct 親指 or 薬指 digits.
こらえる protects 我慢 endurance/restraint, 押さえる's actual suppression and 許す's forgiveness, with distinct objects and social functions preserved.
娯楽 independently overlaps 遊び recreation, 楽しみ enjoyment and 趣味 hobby; no every-pleasant-activity clique.
御覧 protects seeing on ごらんになる/見る/拝見 and trying on 試す/試し. This does not erase honorific versus humble social direction or the post-te-form construction.
コレクション protects collecting/collection on 集める/集まり/集まる and independently 修正 under the externally supported correction homograph. No current JMdict correction sense is invented.

転がす/転がる protect shared roll wording; each independently protects applicable ころころ/ごろごろ rolling. 転がす/倒す uses tipping; 転がる/転ぶ/倒れる/落ちる uses falling. Accurate roll-along versus roll-up wording does not justify a 巻く synonym shortcut.
紺 protects broad 青/青い blue labels without excluding every color. コンクール protects independently verified competition/contest labels on 競争/競技/試合/戦い/大会, not every organized gathering.
コンクリート's material-qualified title does not collide with abstract 具体 or identify cement as the whole mixture.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles and no reuse cover N2:562-N2:581. Community membership, not an official modern JLPT syllabus; secondary recognition does not independently acquire N2.
One new primary reciprocal N2 pair: 零/零れる at こぼれる. Separate 零/こぼす alias link uses visible 零す/こぼす wording and is not a second primary pair.
Missing primary 琴, 遣, 無, 沙, 汰, 娯, 覧 and 紺 remain metadata where written; source 御免 is taught at kana-primary ごめん with no primary 免. No new kanji/stroke article fabricated.
Original source spelling/reading/gloss/entry preserved, especially loose 琴 harp wording and separate コレクション correction homograph. Current sense indices remain spelling/reading-specific.
All 23 public lookups yielded actual lexical bodies; multiple internal homographs/headings do not count as unrestricted shared identities.
Public observations are original concise paraphrases, not copied full lexical bodies. Author receipts are not independent reviewer retrieval.

No executed app quiz draws, measured frequency, native-speaker certification or exhaustive baseline-card rereview. Initial derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; remaining mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess.
